'''Dommik's Crafting Store''' is a [[Crafting shops|Crafting supplies store]] owned by [[Dommik]] located in north-eastern [[Al Kharid]]. It is a convenient place to buy [[Crafting]] supplies due to its close proximity to a [[bank]] and a [[tanner]].

Dommik's Crafting Store has an identical stock to that of [[Rommik's Crafty Supplies]] in [[Rimmington]].
